beliefs: Lowercase letters shift forward by one in the alphabet, except 'z' which wraps to 'a' [E1, E2].
Uppercase letters shift forward by one, except 'Z' which wraps to 'A' [E1, E2].
The shift applies only to the last character of each contiguous run of letters; earlier letters in a run are unchanged [E2].
Digits, spaces, and symbols pass through unchanged [E1, E2].
Empty string maps to empty string [E1].
notes: E2 shows only the final letter of each alphabetic run is shifted (az->aa, za->zb, AaBb->AaBc), not every letter. Wrapping at z/Z to a/A still holds.
